groupDetail.label: Daily exchange rates
groupDetail.description: The daily average exchange rates for various foreign currencies (either currently or historically published) expressed as one unit of the foreign currency converted into Canadian dollars. These rates are typically published once each business day by 16:30 (ET). All Bank of Canada exchange rates are indicative rates only, obtained from averages of aggregated price quotes from financial institutions.

FXAUDCAD.description: Daily average exchange rate: daily value of the Australian dollar expressed in Canadian dollars, for 1 unit of Australian dollar
